parsed.rationale: Regular narrow-complex rhythm with a normal P-QRS-T sequence. The only ST elevation is mild, concave-up and confined to V2–V3 with tall, upright T waves, which fits a normal variant or early repolarization. There are no convex or tombstone ST segments, no pathological Q waves, and no reciprocal ST depression, so STEMI criteria are not met on this tracing, even though the team reads it as an acute STEMI.
